simple.summary: פִּישׁוֹן (Pîyshôwn) means Pishon , a river of Eden First listed occurrence: Gen 2 11.

definitions.full: H6376. Pishon מִּישׁוֺן proper name, of a river (Thes below פושׁ , compare especially Nes Marg. 5 , but dubious); — one of the rivers of Eden Gen 2:11 , Φ ( ε ) ισων , (on theories of identification see Commentaries, also references below גִּיחוֺן ).
